title: DC-area forecast: Fairly bright and less humid today. Rain late tonight into Saturday.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Less humid as we head toward afternoon highs about 80 to 85. Skies are fairly bright despite a mix of sun and clouds.

What's next? Showers develop late tonight. Periods of steadier, heavier rain possible tomorrow, keeping us in the 70s to near 80. Lower rain chances Sunday, then really nice Monday and Tuesday.

Today’s daily digit — 7/10: A reasonably nice August Friday with less humidity.| 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Friday): Fairly bright skies, with some clouds at times. Highs get to a range of about 80 to 85, and it's noticeably less humid with dew points in the upper 50s to low 60s. Light winds come from the north and northeast. Confidence: Medium 😎 Nice Day!

Tonight: Turning cloudier and more humid with time. Showers should move in from the south sometime between midnight and the predawn hours. Lows are in the mid-60s to around 70. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Saturday): Cloudier and cooler as periods of rain move through, maybe some downpours and thunder, perhaps easing with time during the afternoon. Muggy highs in the mid-70s to near 80. Rain amounts could range from as little as 0.25 to 0.5 inches, especially north and west of the Beltway, to as much as 1 to 2 inches, especially from near the Beltway to the south and east. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: A few evening showers and storms remain possible, but lighter and less widespread than earlier in the day. Fairly cloudy and calm with late-night fog possible. Humid 60s for lows. Confidence: Medium

Sunday: Partly to mostly sunny with a decreasing rain chance and slowly lowering humidity. Highs near 80 to mid-80s. Only about a 30 percent chance of a late-day shower or storm, as it looks now. Confidence: Medium

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Sunday night: Clearing, calm, and probably dry. More comfortable lows in the upper 50s to mid-60s. Confidence: Medium

A blissful start to the workweek Monday and Tuesday, with comfortable humidity levels and temperatures. Highs are currently shooting for low to mid-80s both days. Plenty of sunshine expected, with rain chances near zero. Confidence: Medium

Shower and storm chances may return with a little bit more humidity and heat mid- to late week.

DC weather history for August 21

Repeated storms in 2018 dumped record rainfall with intense downpours, leading to flooding and marking one of the heaviest August rain events in years.
